blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Eugenia Duran Apostol, founding chair of the Philippine Daily Inquirer (PDI), died peacefully in her sleep on Sunday, Sept. 13, leaving behind a legacy of journalism defined by the pursuit of truth and justice, and the preservation of press freedom and democracy.
